notes: The Sleeping Ox, Briar Glen's inn (story bible §3.5 and §5.4; mw-ju8.6), kept by Odette "Dot" Farrow (npc-dot), a gossipy, friendly innkeeper. Owner decision 2026-10-04: a night here fully heals (health, stamina, mana), passes time to morning and autosaves; it costs 12 crowns, inside the economy doc's inn-bed band of 8-15 and fixed by the innkeeper (no markup applies to a service). The one room is a service, not stock. The bar sells a little food from items that exist today (no drink items exist yet, so none are sold): bread, cheese, sausage, apples, hot pies and travelling rations, at the default 1.3 markup (band 1.1-1.5) and a 0.4 buy rate (band 0.3-0.6), and she buys food back (consumables) and nothing else. The 120 gold reserve is about ten nights' takings. Full inn service (rumours, drinks, back room fencing for thieves) is mw-e24.4 and mw-e20.9.
